messages:
carmen: :rotating_light: FYI - multiple customer escalations starting ~08:15UTC for hosted inference in eu2/az2. High 5xx rate + long tail latencies. SocialApp and two other customers reporting 20-40% 502/504.

ajay: Copy. Do we have a quick curl repro or logs?

carmen: Pasting a quick repro from a customer run: 
```
$ curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"hello"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2026 08:19:23 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
Connection: close

{"error":"upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response"}
```

mike: Seeing same in our gateway logs for az2-eu2 nodes: repeated `upstream reset` and `timeout waiting for frame`. Also spikes in TCP retransmits on egress interfaces.

sre-bot: alert: hosted-api-eu2-az2-5xx-rate increased to 18% (threshold 5%). Pager: oncall=ops-oncall. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/network-egress-degradation

ops-oncall: I started a tcpdump on the affected host and ran traceroute to customer IPs. Traceroute shows intermittent * * * at hop 6 then long RTTs on hop 7-8.

ops-oncall: traceroute snippet: 
```
traceroute to 84.21.13.45, 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.12.1.1 (10.12.1.1)  0.417 ms  0.366 ms  0.350 ms
 2  10.20.0.1 (10.20.0.1)  0.64 ms  0.63 ms  0.61 ms
 3  198.51.100.1 (198.51.100.1)  4.25 ms  4.12 ms  4.10 ms
 4  * * *
 5  203.0.113.5 (203.0.113.5)  120.3 ms  119.8 ms  121.1 ms
 6  203.0.113.9 (203.0.113.9)  300.2 ms  *  298.9 ms
 7  84.21.13.45 (84.21.13.45)  310.4 ms  308.9 ms  309.6 ms
```

carmen: ops-oncall attached tcpdump extract showing repeated dup ACKs and some ICMP frag messages. Looks like multipath reordering or MTU issues on transit.

support-l2: Customers also reported auth retries followed by billing spikes because clients retried aggressively on 5xx. We blocked a noisy client for now to reduce auth thundering.

ajay: Any BGP churn visible from our side? Route updates?

mike: Yes, recorded small flaps for the transit ASN 65099 starting 08:12UTC. Changes in AS path and next-hop had different egress POPs (eu2-az1 vs eu2-az2) intermittently. Looks like provider multipath balancing with one path experiencing microbursts.

eng-lead: Action plan: 1) Fail traffic for critical routes to eu2-az1 via local route preference for 15m. 2) Open ticket with transit provider with pcap + traceroute + community tag #redwood-eu2. 3) Throttle client retries via gateway (retry jitter + circuit-breaker). 4) Backfill customer with dedicated pool for SLA cases.

carmen: I applied a local route-preference to prefer az1 for new flows (will allow existing KV-cache sessions to finish). Monitoring: 5xx rate dropped from 22% -> 9% within 4 minutes. Still above baseline.

ops-oncall: Provider ticket created SR-2026-4321 with transit NOC. Included BGP update logs, pcap, traceroute, and affected customer list. Asked provider to check PE queue drops and ECMP hashing behavior.

support-l2: For SocialApp, we offered temporary Dedicated pool and updated them on retry/backoff guidance. Legal/finance linked the billing noise to our retrocredits policy - engaged billing to prevent unexpected charges.

ajay: For repro, I created a small script that hits /generate with concurrency 20 and 1s timeout; when run from eu2-az2 it reproduces ~30% 502s, from eu2-az1 it's <1%. Script: 
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"test"}' || echo fail; done
```

mike: Long term: we should add egress path health checks with per-az BGP telemetry and automatic route preference if packetloss > 0.5% for 2m. Also add ECMP-safe hashing to avoid sending hot flows over lossy path.

eng-lead: Agreed. I'll add a ticket to infra backlog for egress path health and auto-failover. Also want an incident postmortem template filled within 48h.

carmen: Thanks everyone. I'll update customers and post an incident summary once provider responds. :thumbsup:
